settings.ordering: nine scenario/seed blocks; rotating scenarios and four Williams policy orders
settings.scope: One h1/h2 flow and its probes; no generated background. Steady 3M tests unnecessary actions; variable scenarios use unchanged 11.5M scale. No fitting or prediction-label construction on rerouted traces.

protocol.review_policy: Preserve all outcomes; pause after first four, no silent failed-run replacements or model retuning

paired.direction: policy minus fixed; loss changes are percentage points, RTT changes milliseconds

summary.interpretation: Descriptive means, observed ranges and sample standard deviations over three seeds. Rows/windows are not independent trials. No confidence or superiority claim from these summaries alone.

scope: Single selected pair; one successful switch per trial; synthetic scenarios and one VM. Received-probe RTT is separate from loaded-probe loss; traffic-window loss remains uncomputed. Inference CPU is already included in policy CPU. Command/readback time is not packet interruption.
